concepts.name: 모여든 번개
concepts.motif: Bold emerald and mint lightning bolts separated by sculpted polished gold.
concepts.progression: 10: one bolt. 50: two converging bolts. 100: three bolts meeting at a small gold core. 1,000: five bolts forming a complete energetic starburst. No glowing effects outside the pin.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / product-mockup.
Create ONE landscape comparison sheet about 2.4:1 aspect ratio showing EXACTLY FOUR premium physical clan enamel pins in one evenly spaced horizontal row, left to right 10, 50, 100, 1,000 milestones.
Family: 모여든 번개. Outer contour shared across all four: a sharp but elegant diamond. Motif: Bold emerald and mint lightning bolts separated by sculpted polished gold.
Specific growth progression, left to right: 10: one bolt. 50: two converging bolts. 100: three bolts meeting at a small gold core. 1,000: five bolts forming a complete energetic starburst. No glowing effects outside the pin.
Materials: rich emerald, pale mint and warm ivory HARD ENAMEL, substantial polished WARM GOLD metal rim and seams, realistic jewelry relief, crisp dimensional bevels and controlled highlights. Gold finish remains identical for every tier. Strong readable silhouettes at 80px, restrained bold forms. No black/silver tier rim, bronze recoloring, emoji, flat app icons, thin vector doodles, real people, watermarks, game logos or branded symbols.
The internal illustration grows through the specified stages; do not just swap a numeral or border color. Keep all objects fully inside the common outer contour.
Presentation: uniform matte charcoal #151918 backdrop, front-facing upright pins, same lighting and maximum pin height, generous spacing, every complete badge clearly visible. Add ONLY plain ivory numeric captions "10", "50", "100", "1,000" OUTSIDE and centered below their corresponding pins. No other lettering, no numerals on the actual jewelry. No case, background scenery, giant frames, glowing effects or missing tiers.

concepts.name: 번개의 코어

concepts.progression: 10: one small crystal. 50: three joined crystal points. 100: five crystal facets creating a crown of energy. 1,000: a complete large crystal star with a small central gold spark. Keep the external metal rim the same.
